items.q: So Fred Jenkins was around New York at the time, so I said, 'No, I don't want to be bothered with a band.'

ctx.x: So Fred Jenkins was around New York at the time, so I said, "No, I don't want to be bothered with a band." I had seen what other band leaders went through and I wanted just to keep my mind on playing and singing. And I didn't -- You know, to keep a bunch of guys working and keep them happy and satisfied, that was a job in itself, --
